evidence: The paper does not use random forest methods or impurity-based variable importance. Statistical analysis relies on ANOVA (with F-statistics and p-values reported as F = X, p = Y), generalized linear mixed models, and AICc-based model selection. The methods section states: "The following packages were used in the analysis: datasets, ggplot2 and lme4 for fitting and analyzing mixed models; nlme for linear and nonlinear mixed effects models; MuMin for model selection." While ranger is listed, it is not mentioned in any analysis description. Results sections exclusively report ANOVA, t-tests, and AICc comparisons without variable importance scores or feature ranking.
